name: dspy-appliance-research-assistant
description: Vertical appliance: a pre-wired DSPy.ts research assistant. Ships a ready-to-run program — a ReAct agent over a search/fetch/notes tool registry, with ReActReflexion (recalls research lessons, records episodes, promotes successful search strategies into skills) → a ChainOfThought synthesizer that writes a grounded, cited answer → a groundedness/coverage metric → MIPROv2 tuning. Commands scaffold it into your repo, run a research query, and tune it.
